mechanism.claim: after two hours of unusually compressed premium-index motion, an efficient ten-minute break that closes outside the compression cage and remains pinned near its directional extreme represents new derivative demand rather than a failed excursion, and may relay into BTCUSDT after a full empty latency bucket
mechanism.why_not_psr: PSR required high-energy alternating motion that returned near its center and traded mean reversion. PCBR requires low-range context, efficient displacement, an outside-cage close, terminal persistence, and trades continuation
mechanism.why_not_price_breakout: the clock contains premium-index OHLC only; BTC price, volume, funding, OI and existing alpha state are excluded

source_contract.gap_policy: all one-minute rows forming each five-minute bar, every 24-bar context, and both trigger bars must be source-valid; no filling

causal_feature_contract.aggregation: five exact completed one-minute premium rows form one completed five-minute premium OHLC bar
causal_feature_contract.decision_time: the close boundary after the second trigger bar
causal_feature_contract.outside_cage: positive move closes above context_high; negative move closes below context_low
causal_feature_contract.strict_prior_thresholds: rolling 8,640 prior five-minute anchors with 8,208 valid values; threshold feature samples are shifted 26 bars so no reference path overlaps the current context or trigger
causal_feature_contract.setup: context_range<=prior q25; abs(trigger_move)>=prior q90; trigger_efficiency>=prior q70; outside_cage; sign(trigger_move)*terminal_location>=0.75; false-to-true onset

execution_contract.feature_available: final one-minute source row is available at T+1s
execution_contract.entry: leave [T,T+5m) empty and enter the BTCUSDT open at T+10m
execution_contract.strict_mdd: global/pre-entry HWM, entry cost, conservative funding boundary marks, every held favorable-then-adverse 5m OHLC path, virtual adverse-mark exit cost, and actual exit cost
execution_contract.cagr: full declared calendar including idle seconds

mechanism_controls.no_compression: retain trigger, outside-cage and terminal gates only
mechanism_controls.no_terminal_pin: retain compression, trigger and outside-cage only
mechanism_controls.no_outside_cage: retain compression, trigger and terminal gates only
mechanism_controls.direction_flip: same primary entries with side multiplied by -1
mechanism_controls.extra_latency_1h: same signal and side with entry and exit delayed 12 bars

rejection_contract.support_failure: reject without opening BTC execution outcomes
rejection_contract.later_failure: reject without threshold direction latency or hold repair

rllm_boundary.future_role: after deterministic passage, an LLM may explain or abstain under a separately frozen policy
